title: Reading Drill — Maintaining cobbled streets — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Maintaining cobbled streets — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The street repair supervisor in Foxhaven received an old report about loose stones moving under delivery trolleys. The report compared the number of displaced stones, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the site inspections rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered six weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include the weight of deliveries. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed different packing around repaired stones as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
